note: No agency publishes a per-fuel unit rate. The rate shown in the explorer is PGCB's published production cost divided by PGCB's published energy, so it is derived (D). This file carries BPDB's independently published cost and energy for the same fuel and day, from a separate report with its own control totals, so the same rate can be derived twice and compared.
administered_note: PGCB applies a flat rate to these rather than reporting an observed cost: across all 137 days of 2026 with cost data, Wind is 14.7100 Tk/kWh on every day and Hydro 0.1000 on all but one.
